contradictions_resolved.resolution: MITRE T1430 technique and scan status are derived from the same evidence object. If no permission or callback bytes are present in evidence_validation, T1430 is removed and status is set to UNKNOWN.
Overlay UI findings and MITRE T1418 are strictly coupled to the existence of SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission or related layout bytes in the evidence registry.
SMS OTP interception telemetry maps to T1647 only when SMS extraction metrics return FOUND.
Shell command indicators map to T1406 only when Ljava/lang/Runtime;->exec is detected in bytecode.
Clone detection threat metrics map to T1474 only when brand and package similarities match clone criteria.
Reputation findings map to T1473 only when unknown/invalid certificates are cryptographic realities.

engine_conformance.report_generator: PDFReportGenerator dynamically builds scan fields using risk.evidence_validation. No hardcoded mock assertions or text mismatches exist.
